title: Navigating the “Answer Era”: Activating High-Intent Consumption in an AI-First World
summary: Generative AI is reshaping product discovery. Learn how Teads helps brands win high-intent consumers in the Answer Era with trusted media and AI creative.
body_markdown:
Product discovery is undergoing one of its biggest shifts in decades. We have entered the “Answer Era” – where consumers increasingly prompt, query, and expect immediate guidance. As generative AI compresses discovery into recommended answers, showing up in the right environment becomes more than a media placement: it becomes a credibility signal.


**[The Connected Consumer Blueprint, Volume 3](https://view-su2.highspot.com/viewer/1e5c36ed0f1aa82297aad9fd3d37ddaa)** explores how brands can respond, combining premium editorial environments, the new query generating real estate and AI-powered creative to turn active consideration into action.


## **The Industry Challenge: Search Fragmentation and Consumer Trust**


Conversational discovery creates challenges for established and emerging brands alike: being omitted from an answer, or struggling to enter the consideration set. The response is not to replace brand strategy with AI, but to strengthen the evidence, relevance and practical utility that help consumers choose.


Data from our research partners at GWI and Censuswide featured in the report highlights three priorities:


**Respond to AI-assisted discovery:** 52.6% of active consumers are using chat assistants for product recommendations and shopping research, led by next-gen buyers. Assess how your brand appears across the questions buyers ask – not just traditional search results.


**Reach the lean-in mindset:** Teads open-web audiences are 41% more likely to use AI to streamline product decisions and 45% more likely to use it for automobile research than average UK internet users. Connect discovery with trusted content that supports active evaluation.


**Make creative useful:** 51.5% of Millennials and 37.5% of Gen Z demand clear pricing, promotional offers, and local availability to feature prominently. Answer practical purchase questions within the ad, rather than leaving every answer to the landing page.\[4\]


### **The Teads Solve: The Lean-In Frontier**


Volume 3 explores **The Lean-In Frontier** : a roadmap for winning consumer intent as search fragments into conversational AI streams. Rather than treating AI as a substitute for brand strategy, Teads deploys three ways of putting those insights into practice:


● **Earned Media and LLM Integrations:** Teads is working to empower brand visibility in the answer era through amplifying advertisers in high-trust 3rd-party earned media (editorial reviews and publisher articles) whilst working on allowing them to show up in relevant intentional environments which can supercharge the open web activity


● **Predictive Pre-Testing with Neurons:** Utilizing visual AI models trained on EEG brainwave data, Teads pre-tests creative assets pre-flight to guarantee maximum focus and minimal cognitive strain—delivering proven brand lifts without sacrificing brand soul.


● **Generative Voice Personalisation with AudioStack:** Dynamically adapts video messaging with localized voiceovers and contextual cues to transform national campaigns into intimate, highly relevant consumer conversations.
